title: Implement recurring schedules and stable lesson exceptions
verify: Recurring schedule creates planned lessons and add/transfer/cancel affects only the selected repetition.

The scheduling boundary preserves lesson identity and scheduling-owned context on transfer, exposes assignment-based access decisions, and retains authored attribution; Financial Ledger integration confirms no duplicate chargeable lesson.
evidence_required: FT-002-AC-003 RED: recurring schedule does not create planned repetitions or an exception changes unrelated repetitions; GREEN: planned lessons are created and add/transfer/cancel changes only the selected lesson; artifact: .tasks/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/ and .protocols/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/verification.md.

FT-002-AC-004 RED: transfer changes scheduling-owned lesson identity/context or creates a duplicate chargeable lesson; GREEN: the same identity retains scheduling-owned context and Financial Ledger integration confirms no duplicate chargeable lesson; downstream material, personal, and discussion projections remain consumer-owned; artifact: .tasks/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/ and .protocols/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/verification.md.

FT-002-AC-005 RED: an assigned teacher does not receive the scheduling boundary's historical class-scope authorization decision; GREEN: the current assignment permits the decision and authored records retain attribution, while Lesson Context owns composition of educational, personal, and discussion projections; artifact: .tasks/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/ and .protocols/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/verification.md.

FT-002-AC-006 RED: a removed teacher/member remains authorized by the scheduling boundary or authored attribution is lost; GREEN: the next scheduling authorization check denies class-scope access/change and authored records retain attribution, while downstream consumers enforce the same decision for their projections; artifact: .tasks/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/ and .protocols/TASK-006-T2-FT-002-W4/verification.md.
purpose: Provide stable scheduling-owned lesson facts and assignment authorization decisions used by calendar, learning, collaboration, and financial slices.
success_outcome: Recurring lessons are created, selected exceptions are independently changed, transferred lessons retain scheduling-owned identity/context, assignment authorization changes take effect immediately, authored attribution is preserved, and Financial Ledger integration prevents duplicate chargeable lesson identities.
anti_goals: Do not create duplicate chargeable lesson identities.
Do not compose Lesson Context, Collaboration, or Learning Progress projections in Center & Scheduling.
constraints: Center & Scheduling exclusively writes lesson and schedule state.
Historical access depends on current assignment authorization.
invariants: A moved lesson retains its identity.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-003: recurring schedule creation and selected add/transfer/cancel exception with unaffected-repetition comparison.
FT-002-AC-004: transfer identity and scheduling-owned context plus Financial Ledger duplicate-charge uniqueness assertion; downstream projections are consumed through accepted boundaries.
FT-002-AC-005: assigned-teacher scheduling authorization decision with pre-assignment attribution fixtures; downstream Lesson Context composition is not owned here.
FT-002-AC-006: immediate post-removal scheduling authorization denial while authored-record attribution remains; downstream consumers use the same boundary decision.

stop_conditions: Stop if schedule changes require a new global lifecycle decision.
